snippet.title: Slots & Daggers Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Out now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3631290/Slots__Daggers

From the creator of SUMMERHOUSE comes SLOTS & DAGGERS - a compact retro-fantasy roguelike where battles play out on a slot machine. Arm yourself to the teeth and set out on an adventure across strange and dangerous lands, where every spin could be your last!
